Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "Ami Neta Hobo came out first" in Step 11. The evidence gathered in previous steps clearly showed that *Hood of the Living Dead* was released in August 2005, while *Ami Neta Hobo* was released in February 2018. Since 2005 is earlier than 2018, *Hood of the Living Dead* came out first. The Planner failed to perform the basic logical comparison of the dates (2005 < 2018) and drew the opposite conclusion.
